fixes.explanation: Yes, friend. "All this is for the transgression of Jacob and the sins of the house of Israel." (Micah 1:5). The melting and splitting aren't random. The text ties them straight to those sins. Then it asks what the transgression of Jacob is, and answers with Samaria.
Yes, friend. "…I will destroy all her idols." (Micah 1:7). The verse says her carved images will be smashed to pieces too. So the idols are on the list of what goes down along with the city.
